title: The site's standard, its scope, and the documents included
instruction: Parts 1 and 2 are in your own words. Nothing is suggested, by ruling: no model drafts them. Part 3 lists the documents the site uses. For each, sign it in, leave it out with a reason, or leave it for later. Nothing enters the data from this console. Your answers are kept in the signed record until a locked change writes them.

statements.title: 1. The site's statement of its standard
statements.label: The statement of the standard, in your words
statements.plain: Write the site's statement of its own standard. It must say three things: the standard can be wrong, Scripture is its judge, and the witnesses are shown so that the reader can test it.
context: Until this is signed, the site shows: "The site's statement of its standard is not yet signed."

statements.title: 2. The site's statement of its scope
statements.label: The statement of the scope, in your words
statements.plain: Write the site's statement of its scope. It must say which traditions the site covers, and why.
context: The four tests in Decision 1 (published, attributable, public domain or licensed, a page witness) are formal only. Which traditions are covered is yours to state.

inclusion.title: 3. Documents included (ADR-0009, signed as one batch)
inclusion.plain: Choose "include" to sign this document in as in scope, "leave out" to record it as considered and not included (write why in the next box), or "not now" to leave it as not yet considered.
inclusion.reason_plain: If you chose "leave out", write the reason: it is shown on the list of documents left out. Otherwise leave this empty.
